# yyzTools

> yyzTools (short for "Yes Your Zen Tools") is a free, local-first Windows desktop productivity toolkit. It bundles 40+ integrated modules — command palette, dock, clipboard history, super translation, OCR, file preview, batch rename / image / video / PDF processing, live wallpaper, and desktop effects — in a single installer. 12 interface languages, no account, no paid tiers.

Key facts:
- Price: free forever — no paid unlocks, no membership tiers
- Platform: 64-bit Windows 10 (1809+) / Windows 11, ~600 MB disk
- Privacy: local-first — clipboard, search, and OCR data stay on the device; no account, no telemetry
- Interface languages: English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Français, Deutsch, Español, Русский, العربية, Português, Italiano
- Distribution: GitHub Releases (installer built with Inno Setup)
- Command modules: 379 extensible .zenmod commands (AI / App / Game / Sys / Web)
